result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by DX19. I kept 'operate alongside' state antitrust law in the summary only. It does not establish supersession or preemption, so supersedes_state_rule and may_preempt_local_rules stay null. The software exemptions (public data, aggregate historical data, affordable-housing compliance tools) concern the landlord's pricing tools, not buildings, units or owners. They are left out of coverage. DX19 gives no unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits. The 1995 cutoff and 15-year exemption in D085 apply to the rent stabilization and just cause ordinances, not this ordinance.
